title: Correction
hook: Correction is part of the model.

launchpad.outcome: Confirm correction only when a candle closes back through the PIL, and stop reading it as failure.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Did price close back through the PIL?

slides.heading: Correction = a close BACK through the PIL

beats.title: Bullish
beats.line: Indication closed ABOVE → correction closes back BELOW.

beats.title: Bearish
beats.line: Indication closed BELOW → correction closes back ABOVE.

slides.punch: Correction is NOT failure. It’s literally part of the model.

slides.quote: If price never corrects, we don’t invent the correction because we want the trade.

slides.prompt: Why is correction “good” and not a problem?
slides.modelAnswer: Because it’s a required part of the sequence. Without a close back through the PIL there is no Dayli ICC, so the pullback is something I wait for, not something I fear.

takeaways: Correction = close back through the PIL.
Correction is part of the model.
remember: If price never corrects, we don’t invent the correction.
